items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then the next one is Flute By-Laws. Again, Chick is back, but the bass player is Cachao. / Cachao didn’t play on every one. Cachao may have played on . . .

ctx.x: Then the next one is Flute By-Laws. Again, Chick is back, but the bass player is Cachao.
Cachao didn’t play on every one. Cachao may have played on . . .
And then Richard Davis on the other session. This was the first session.
